verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe is a transcription API: it returns transcripts, speaker and channel labels, timestamps, and polished text, but nothing that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. Summaries and similar artifacts come from passing the transcript to a separate Summarizer API, which is a different product. Text Polishing only cleans up the transcript, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Pass a completed transcript to the Summarizer API when your application needs those artifacts.
